nodes.explanation: Someone types or pastes a sentence they want the computer to understand or continue.
nodes.label: Reading input words

nodes.explanation: The sentence is cut into small pieces called tokens, such as words or word parts.
nodes.label: Splitting into tokens

nodes.explanation: Each token becomes a list of numbers for its meaning, plus a signal for its position.
nodes.label: Adding word vectors

nodes.explanation: Every word is compared with every other word to see which links matter most.
nodes.label: Comparing every word pair

nodes.explanation: Each comparison becomes a weight, so every word knows what to pay attention to.
nodes.label: Weighing important words

nodes.explanation: Each word blends in meaning from the words it linked to, gaining full context.
nodes.label: Blending meanings together

nodes.explanation: A small network polishes each word's numbers, and the block repeats many times.
nodes.label: Refining each word

nodes.explanation: The final numbers become chances for each possible next word, and one is picked.
nodes.label: Predicting the next word

title: How a transformer reads a sentence
